strings.name: Richard Branson
strings.summary: Branson left school as a teenager and built Virgin from Student magazine and mail-order records into music, aviation, communications and tourism. Branding, licensing and adventures shaped his public image. He also invested in commercial spaceflight and flew suborbitally in 2021. International expansion came alongside test-flight accidents, financial strain and Virgin Orbit’s bankruptcy.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 13 November 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Founded the Virgin brand and businesses spanning aviation and tourism, influencing brand licensing and corporate communication.
